GST on Property

Affordable 1% / Non-affordable 5%
FY 2026-27

Brokerage + TDS

Commission, TDS 5% (194-IB), net
FY 2026-27
Commission pe TDS 194-IB 5% + GST 18% as per invoice. PAN/Form 16A ke liye CA se confirm karein.

Rental Yield + Payback

Monthly rent se yield aur payback
Yield = (Rent × (12 − vacancy)) / Value. BCS corridor rent comps se rent validate karein.
📐

Plot Area Converter

sq ft ↔ sq yd ↔ bigha ↔ kanal ↔ acre
Rajasthan bigha = 2529 sq yd (pakka), kanal = 505.33 sq yd (kaccha alag). Registry document ka unit dekho.
🧮

Affordability (FOIR)

Monthly income se max loan
Rule of thumb: EMI ≤ FOIR% of monthly income. Existing EMI ghatakar recompute karein.
⏱️

Prepayment + Saving

Lump-sum prepay se kitna bacha
Prepay charges floating rate pe generally nil — bank letter confirm karein. Tenure vs EMI kam ka option dekho.

RERA Delay Interest

MCLR + 2% — promised date se delay
RERA Act
RERA section 31 / rules: bank MCLR + 2% interest. Exact SBI MCLR at delay date confirm karein.

DLC Rate (Circle) — Jaipur Collector

Rajasthan e-Panjiyan • Information Services → e-Value (Online DLC)
Jaipur • DLC
↗ Check online — e-Panjiyan epanjiyan.rajasthan.gov.in · District → Urban/Rural → SRO → Zone → Colony → Captcha → Show Result
Kaise check karein (6 steps)
  1. e-Panjiyan portal pe jao — epanjiyan.rajasthan.gov.in
  2. Information Services me ja ke “e-Value (Online DLC)” chun lo
  3. District: Jaipur select karo
  4. Urban ya Rural select karo
  5. Apna Sub-Registrar Office (SRO), phir zone aur colony/locality select karo
  6. Captcha bharo → Show Result — wahan residential / commercial / industrial / agricultural ke alag-alag rate aur kabhi exterior vs interior alag dikhenge

Registry duty max(market value, DLC value) pe lagti hai — deal se pehle latest DLC zaroor verify karo. Neeche BCS default rates sirf indicative hain.

DLC (Collector rate) — Jaipur me sab ise circle rate kehte hain; official name DLC hai. Result me residential/commercial/industrial/agri aur exterior/interior alag ho sakte hain. e-Value (Online DLC) se latest verify karo.
🗺️

State-wise Stamp Duty & Registration

Sab states — indicative rates, women concession ke saath
India · FY 2026-27
Rates state registration dept ke indicative hain — sub-city slab se alag ho sakte hain.
Duty MAX(agreement, circle) par lagti hai. Concessions: mahila, first-home, affordable schemes state-wise. Delhi slab-based (≤₹25L kam), MH city-wise, KA zonal — exact rate registration dept site se verify karein.
🧾

TDS on Purchase — Sec 194-IA (buyer pays)

₹50L+ purchase par 1% — Form 26QB, 30 din
Income-tax Act
Buyer khud TDS deposit karta hai — Form 26QB (7 din me) + Form 16B seller ko 15 din me. TDS sirf resident seller par 1%; NRI seller par Sec 195 (12.5%+ ya lower deduction certificate) — CA se plan karayein.
📊

Capital Gains on Sale

LTCG 12.5% / 20%+indexation · STCG slab
FY 2026-27
Holding ≤2 saal → STCG (slab rate, indexation nahi). >2 saal → option A: 12.5% flat without indexation, ya option B: 20% with indexation — dono compare karke kam tax chunein. Exemption: Sec 54 (residential house reinvest) / 54EC bonds ₹50L cap. CII latest Income-tax portal se.
🏗️

Construction Cost Estimator

Jaipur rates — basic se luxury tak
Jaipur · 2026
Turnkey civil + finishing (structure, plaster, flooring, electrical, plumbing, paint). Land, approval fees, bore/tank alag. Jaipur market me labour + material variation 10-15% — contractor BOQ se confirm karein. Plot me basemen/stilt alag rate hota hai.

Rates har notification pe badal sakte hain — upar Rates Studio me ek jagah update karo. Final legal/tax advice ke liye CA/advocate se confirm karein.

My custom fields

Har section ke apne fields bana sakte hain — jo aapko chahiye, jab chahiye. Type choose karein: text, number, date, checkbox, dropdown ya multi-select. “In list” tick karne par ye column list/table view mein bhi dikhega.

Dropdowns & lists — full freedom

Har dropdown / list ko add, rename, hide, reorder ya delete kar sakte hain. “Built-in” items ko delete nahi kar sakte, lekin “Hide” karke kahi bhi chhupa sakte hain — data safe rehta hai. Naye items har form, filter, list table aur analytics me turant dikhne lagte hain.
